writing:wr:6.hint: ある集団や場所に所属している、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:6.answer: This book belongs to the school library.
writing:wr:6.fullSentence: This book belongs to the school library.

writing:wr:7.hint: 何かをした後で後悔している、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:7.answer: He regretted that he had not studied harder.
writing:wr:7.fullSentence: He regretted that he had not studied harder.
writing:wr:7.explanation: 後悔の内容をthat節で述べる。

writing:wr:8.hint: 考えや気持ちを言葉に出して伝える、という意味の動詞は何か。
writing:wr:8.answer: It is important to express your feelings honestly.
writing:wr:8.fullSentence: It is important to express your feelings honestly.
writing:wr:8.explanation: 自分の考えや感情を表す動詞。

writing:wr:9.hint: 何かに良い影響や悪い影響を持つ、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:9.answer: Sleep deprivation can have a negative effect on health.
writing:wr:9.fullSentence: Sleep deprivation can have a negative effect on health.
writing:wr:9.explanation: 影響を及ぼすという意味の表現。

writing:wr:10.hint: できる限り多くの努力をする、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:10.answer: She made every effort to finish the project on time.
writing:wr:10.fullSentence: She made every effort to finish the project on time.
writing:wr:10.explanation: 最大限努力するという意味の表現。

writing:wr:11.hint: 意見や決心を変える、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:11.answer: She changed her mind at the last minute.
writing:wr:11.fullSentence: She changed her mind at the last minute.
writing:wr:11.explanation: 決心や考えを変える動作。

writing:wr:12.hint: 答えの出ない問題をうまく解決する、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:12.answer: It took him hours to solve the math problem.
writing:wr:12.fullSentence: It took him hours to solve the math problem.

writing:wr:13.hint: 試験中に不正な方法で答えを得る、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:13.answer: It is forbidden to cheat on an exam.
writing:wr:13.fullSentence: It is forbidden to cheat on an exam.
writing:wr:13.explanation: 試験でずるをする行為。

writing:wr:14.hint: 誕生日などのお祝いの会を催す、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:14.answer: They are going to have a party this weekend.
writing:wr:14.fullSentence: They are going to have a party this weekend.

writing:wr:15.hint: 自転車に乗って学校に行く、という日常的な行動を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:15.answer: Many students cycle to school every morning.
writing:wr:15.fullSentence: Many students cycle to school every morning.
writing:wr:15.explanation: 自転車で通学する表現。

writing:wr:16.hint: ある事柄が実現する可能性がある、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:16.answer: There is a possibility that it will rain tomorrow.
writing:wr:16.fullSentence: There is a possibility that it will rain tomorrow.
writing:wr:16.explanation: 可能性を表す名詞構文。

writing:wr:17.hint: 道に迷ってどこにいるか分からなくなる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:17.answer: We lost our way in the old town.
writing:wr:17.fullSentence: We lost our way in the old town.
writing:wr:17.explanation: 迷子になるという意味。

writing:wr:18.hint: 直接会って話す、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:18.answer: It is better to talk face to face about this matter.
writing:wr:18.fullSentence: It is better to talk face to face about this matter.
writing:wr:18.explanation: 対面で話すという意味。

writing:wr:19.hint: 体重が増える、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:19.answer: He gained weight after eating fast food every day.
writing:wr:19.fullSentence: He gained weight after eating fast food every day.

writing:wr:20.hint: 他人からの信頼を得る、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:20.answer: It takes time to gain the trust of your colleagues.
writing:wr:20.fullSentence: It takes time to gain the trust of your colleagues.
writing:wr:20.explanation: 信頼を得るという意味。

writing:wr:21.hint: 大学に入学することを表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:21.answer: It is his dream to get into college next year.
writing:wr:21.fullSentence: It is his dream to get into college next year.
writing:wr:21.explanation: 大学に入るという意味。

writing:wr:22.hint: たまたま、思いがけず何かをする、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:22.answer: I happened to meet my old friend on the train.
writing:wr:22.fullSentence: I happened to meet my old friend on the train.

writing:wr:23.hint: 電車の中で自分の降りるべき駅を通り過ぎてしまう、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:23.answer: I was so tired that I missed my station.
writing:wr:23.fullSentence: I was so tired that I missed my station.
writing:wr:23.explanation: 自分の駅を過ぎてしまうという意味。

writing:wr:24.hint: あることを心から好んでいる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:24.answer: She is fond of classical music.
writing:wr:24.fullSentence: She is fond of classical music.
writing:wr:24.explanation: 好んでいるという意味。

writing:wr:25.hint: 花粉症の症状に悩まされている状態を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:25.answer: He has hay fever every spring.
writing:wr:25.fullSentence: He has hay fever every spring.
writing:wr:25.explanation: 花粉症にかかっているという状態。

writing:wr:26.hint: 法的・社会的に成人として認められる年齢になる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:26.answer: In Japan, people come of age at eighteen.
writing:wr:26.fullSentence: In Japan, people come of age at eighteen.
writing:wr:26.explanation: 成人になるという意味。

writing:wr:27.hint: 実際の現場で経験を積む、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:27.answer: Students can gain practical experience through internships.
writing:wr:27.fullSentence: Students can gain practical experience through internships.
writing:wr:27.explanation: 実践的な経験を積むという意味。

writing:wr:28.hint: 何も考えずただそれだけを繰り返す、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:28.answer: He does nothing but complain about his job.
writing:wr:28.fullSentence: He does nothing but complain about his job.

writing:wr:29.hint: ある場所で生まれ、その後そこで育つ、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:29.answer: She was born and brought up in a small village.
writing:wr:29.fullSentence: She was born and brought up in a small village.
writing:wr:29.explanation: 生まれ育つという意味。

writing:wr:30.hint: ある結果や物事について責任を負う立場にある、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:30.answer: The manager is responsible for the team's performance.
writing:wr:30.fullSentence: The manager is responsible for the team's performance.
writing:wr:30.explanation: 責任があるという意味。
